intent: Logitech C270 stays at 30 fps in Google Meet (Helium) in low light instead of dropping to ~15 fps and looking laggy.
scope: Non-goal: manual exposure lock; auto exposure stays on
changes: udev rule sets exposure_dynamic_framerate=0 on the C270 capture node at every add event
Installer script with install/--remove/--status; installs v4l-utils if missing

verification.evidence: User confirmed Meet video no longer laggy
Rule installed then removed in vmbox, rc=0
Host control read back exposure_dynamic_framerate: 0 after simulated plug-in

risks: Darker, noisier picture in dim rooms (fixed 33 ms max exposure)
Chromium could start resetting this control in a future version, undoing the rule per stream
rollback: v4l2-ctl -d /dev/video0 -C exposure_dynamic_framerate reads the firmware value again
